ctx.x: And how old were you when you started listening to the Duke Ellington Orchestra?

Oh, boy, wait a minute. The first time I heard him on the radio. He was working at exclusive clubs there, and he would come on maybe 15 minutes, about dinner time. That's the way they were doing it in those days on radio. I guess I was about 13, 14. You know, 13 or 14. And he shocked me. I don't know, I guess he meant to shock everybody. He had Cootie Williams playing and around Chicago in those days we had oh, Jan Garber, and everybody listening to Guy Lombardo. And about dinner time Duke would have Cootie…
